title: Speaking Practice 24 - Media and Information
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about media and information.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Media and Information Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: How has social media changed the way people get news?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Social media has made news instant and accessible, but also created problems with misinformation. Many people now get news from Facebook or TikTok rather than traditional newspapers.

questions.content: Do you think social media does more harm than good?

explanation.sampleAnswer: It depends on how it is used. For connecting people and sharing information, it is valuable. But cyberbullying, addiction, and fake news are serious concerns.

questions.content: Should there be stricter regulations on social media?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I believe there should be, particularly regarding data privacy and content moderation. Platforms should be held accountable for the spread of harmful misinformation.

questions.content: How can people identify fake news?

explanation.sampleAnswer: By checking multiple sources, looking at the credibility of the publisher, and being skeptical of sensational headlines. Media literacy should be taught in schools.

questions.content: Will traditional media like newspapers survive?

explanation.sampleAnswer: In print form, probably not. But many newspapers have successfully transitioned to digital platforms and continue to produce high-quality journalism.
